mutants.label: #1 Rayleigh cross-section goes as lambda^-3 instead of lambda^-4 (level at 550 nm kept)
mutants.why: A resolution limit of the control, accepted by the conductor, not an unguarded renderer property. The control's tolerances are fixed by issue #34 (0.10 log units on the lowest band's contrast, 0.02 in u'v'), and an exponent of 3 moves that band's log(B/G) by 0.044 and u'v' by 0.002, inside both at every azimuth; only a grey Rayleigh (row 1b) turns the control red. The existing physics tests kill this mutation (tests/test_render_atmosphere.py::test_rayleigh_scattering_falls_roughly_as_wavelength_to_the_minus_four and tests/test_render_physics.py::test_a_very_thin_atmosphere_shows_rayleigh_scattered_sunlight), and the renderer-v1 check (#35) pins v1's output separately. A drift pin on the measured deviations was proposed and declined.

G5 [gap] the u'v' distance is the largest axis difference instead of the Euclidean distance
#6 [control] u' computed as (8 x) / (2 denominator) in the u'v' helper
mutants.why: Multiplying numerator and denominator of u' by 2 is exact in IEEE-754 (a power of two only shifts the exponent), so (8.0 * x) / (2.0 * denominator) is bit-identical to 4.0 * x / denominator for every finite input, and v' is untouched. Inert over every path the file reaches (the D65 known-white test, the control, the self-comparison that must equal 0.0); it would matter only to a test that pinned the helper's source text.
